title: numpy.fft.fft — NumPy v2.4 Manual
snippet: fft.fft(a, n=None, axis=-1, norm=None, out=None). Compute the one-dimensional discrete Fourier Transform using the efficient Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithm.

title: Discrete Fourier Transform — NumPy v2.4 Manual
snippet: fft(a[, n, axis, norm, out]) computes the one-dimensional discrete Fourier Transform. fftn computes the N-dimensional discrete Fourier Transform. The DFT has become a mainstay of numerical computing because of the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithm.
